goal: Generate missing answers, add distractors to short MCQs, and produce explanations + key concepts for every question, using the CNS book as reference
summary: Phase 2 complete. All 3,537 questions enriched with explanation and keyConcept. All 10 batch-enriched JSON files created. Combined flat array (interim/combined-enriched.json) contains 3,537 items. Per-chapter JSON files created in interim/chapters/.
stepSummaries:
1. Split the interim JSON into ~10 batches of ~350 questions each, grouping by chapter where possible so each batch references the same book section [verified]
  2. Dispatch 3 parallel Builder subagents (max 3 concurrent) to process batches 1-3, each receiving the conversion prompt + relevant CNS book sections + batch JSON [verified]
  3. Continue dispatching parallel Builder subagents for remaining batches until all 10 batches are enriched [verified]
  4. Combine all enriched batches into a single combined JSON array and deduplicate the Flagged Review List entries [verified]
